Name: Harvest_Feast_Miller
$Comment: Tomas the Miller's conversation, one of the three villagers standing in the Forgotten Temple while
Harvest Feast runs. Tomas contracts everything: I've, it's, don't.
Start's First beat answers a visit while the feast is off (after a command ends it, or when a server
owner stands Tomas somewhere all year) with one line and goodbye. Otherwise the conversation opens on
greeting, the Fallback. A conversation has no Season leaf, so the off-season beat reads the feature
Tomas gives no quest and credits no talk of his own. The invitation tour's line is not in this file:
DialogueExtensions/SeasonsOfOrbis/Harvest_Feast_Invitation.json adds it to the screens a
conversation opens on while the player carries the tour, after a screen's own lines and before the
goodbye group, so goodbye stays last. That line is spent once a day per conversation, which is why
each villager has a conversation of their own.
